Subject: Post-discovery: coordinate engineering roster & pick a 60-90m window

Thanks again for the call earlier — good discussion. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the technical session: 

Summary (1-sentence): Orchid wants to validate production latency and deployment options for ML models and needs a combined ML/infra workshop to confirm fit and uplift estimates.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical workshop with our infra + model-serving engineers. Goals:
- Walk through request/throughput profile and SLOs
- Show a short demo of the runtime for a representative model (quantized and FP16 perf)
- Outline rolling rollout + fallback and discuss data controls (VPC/KMS)

Suggested agenda (flexible, we can shorten to 60 or extend to 90):
1) 10m — introductions + objectives
2) 20m — workload profile & constraints (Orchid)
3) 25m — runtime architecture + demo (Redwood)
4) 20m — deployment options and SLO tradeoffs
5) 10–15m — open Q&A / next actions

Times we can offer next week (please mark preferences):
- Tue 2026-06-22: 10:00–11:15 PT (75m)
- Wed 2026-06-23: 09:00–10:30 PT (90m)
- Thu 2026-06-24: 13:00–14:15 PT (75m)

Can you confirm: (a) preferred slot, (b) who from Orchid will attend (ML lead + infra/ops ideal), and (c) a short list of one or two specific demo scenarios (e.g., 2k-token batch vs streaming low-latency) you want us to prioritize?

I attached a light mutual action plan and a small pack of prereads that we'll use as the baseline.

Thanks — I can coordinate calendars once you pick a slot.

—
